text:
Before: a yogurt cup (about 125 g, peaches and cream), two glasses of orange juice (about 250 ml each), one fried egg, and one banana.

After: the yogurt is almost entirely gone, the juice glasses have only a small residue, the egg is eaten, and only the banana peel remains.

| Item | Mass eaten | Energy |
|---|---|---|
| Banana (about 120 g edible flesh) | 120 g | 107 kcal |
| Orange juice (2 × about 240 g, minus about 20 g residue) | 460 g | 207 kcal |
| Fried egg | 46 g | 90 kcal |
| Yogurt (about 120 g eaten, roughly 100 kcal per 100 g) | 120 g | 120 kcal |
| **Total** | **746 g** | **524 kcal** |
